'''Gideon''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During [[Operation Cobolt]], Gideon and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Toombs]] were in command of the assault teams that would be entering the [[Imperial orbital base]] over [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] during an attempt to recover an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Scandoc coding computer]].
